dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Giants Blast Cubs in 18-3 Rout, Rutschman Leads Orioles to 13-3 Win**

The San Francisco Giants put on a show, trouncing the Chicago Cubs 18-3 behind a 2-HR, 8-RBI performance from Matt Chapman. Casey Schmitt also homered for the Giants, his 15th of the season. On the mound, Robbie Ray pitched 5 strong innings, striking out 4 and allowing just 2 hits.

Meanwhile, Adley Rutschman went 4-for-4 with a home run and 5 RBIs to lead the Baltimore Orioles to a 13-3 win over the Toronto Blue Jays. Rutschman's performance was part of a balanced attack that saw several Orioles players contribute to the win.

In other games, the Houston Astros beat the Athletics 5-1 behind a 4-K performance from Mason Barnett, while the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Colorado Rockies 9-7 in a back-and-forth contest.
